data.name: Description
data.value: Storage Box from Hetzner, reached over SSH on port 23. Enable "SSH support" for the Storage Box in the Hetzner Console first.

data.name: UserHint
data.value: e.g. u123456, or u123456-sub1 for a sub-account. The server name follows from it.

data.name: PathHint
data.value: Relative to the Storage Box home directory, e.g. backups/laptop

data.name: RemoteBorgLabel
data.value: borg version on the Storage Box

data.name: RemoteBorgHint
data.value: The borg Hetzner runs for this repository. borg 1.4 works with borg 1.2 and 1.4 on this computer.

data.name: UserRequired
data.value: Please enter the Storage Box user.

data.name: UserInvalid
data.value: The user looks like u123456, or u123456-sub1 for a sub-account.

data.name: PathNotRelative
data.value: Enter the repository path relative to the Storage Box home directory, without a leading "/", e.g. backups/laptop.

data.name: PathInvalid
data.value: The repository path may only contain letters (a–z), digits, ".", "_", "-", "+" and "/", and no ".." folders.
